per_window.ps-ns: dynamic_in_window at the ends only, in full-length CDNF (no isolated-domain data). Linker residues 103-113 (entry 2-12) have low NOE (CDNFCT-J1, r1) and K158-L161 (entry 57-60) have low R2/R1 and NOE (J2, r1); the C-terminal helices 118-127 and 138-152 show no large fast motion (J3, r1, r3, measured_not_detected).
per_window.us-ms: unresolved. C132, R133 and K138 (entry 31, 32, 37) are broadened beyond detection, which the authors attribute to millisecond exchange (J5, r2); the 2021 MES sample repeats the claim for unlisted residues (J6, r6). No dispersion, rate or population exists; the dispersion search returned no hits.
per_window.undetermined: R2/R1-only motions at D112, L125, Y141, Y152, A154, T155 (J4, unresolved); semi-independent domain reorientation in the full-length protein (J7); alpha-synuclein shift perturbations at V118, Q123, S127 (J8, binding, unresolved); MANF paralog disorder claim (J9, abstract only). Not judged: N-terminal domain crystal versus solution comparison (r4, outside the entry domain), alpha-synuclein MST affinity (r7, binding constant), CDNF-BiP MD abstract (r8, no CDNF motion described).

protein_summary.wt_apo_answer: Not measured on the isolated 60-residue domain: in full-length wild-type apo CDNF (25 °C, pH 6, phosphate with EDTA) the only us-ms sign is qualitative, with the amides of C132, R133 and K138 (entry 31, 32, 37) broadened beyond detection, which the authors attribute to millisecond exchange, and no dispersion, rate or population.
open_conflicts: Paralog claim versus target structure, not a same-protein conflict: the MANF abstract calls its C-terminus natively unfolded (r9), while full-length CDNF has a folded C-terminal domain with no large fast motion (r1, r3).
Broadened-residue lists differ inside the 2015 paper: the Methods list of missing HN includes A134, the Results exchange text names only C132, R133 and K138 (r2).
questions_for_gina: Which study supplied the RelaxDB CDNFCT relaxation set? The input lists no BMRB id, and PDB 2LPN (an isolated C-terminal domain structure) is tied to no evidence row.
Should full-length CDNF relaxation (linker and domain context) count toward the isolated-domain entry, or only as inference?
protein_summary.buffer_note: All 2015 data are on full-length CDNF in 20 mM phosphate pH 6 with 1 mM EDTA (added against proteolysis); no phosphate or EDTA artefact is shown, and the 2021 MES pH 7 sample still lacks some amides. The 2015 paper gives R1/R2 at 800 MHz in Methods but 600 MHz in the Figure 2 caption, and prints dimensionless R2/R1 averages with s-1; both kept as printed. Second read: rows r1, r3 and r4 are 'unverified' on residue identity (figure-only lists); values, sample and method matched. Every evidence-bearing judgment is is_wt_apo false because the construct is not the isolated domain; only the search-gap judgment J10 is scored for the isolated WT domain.
